import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution {
	public static void main( String[] args ) {
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		String s = "";
		try {
			s = in.nextLine();
		}
		catch (Exception e){
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		in.close();
		
		System.out.println(get(s));
	}
	
	public static int get( String s ) {
		if (s.isEmpty()) {
			return 0;
		}
		String[] runs = s.split("(?<=(.))(?!\\1)");
		int ret = 0;
		for (String run : runs) {
			if (!run.isEmpty() && run.length() % 2 == 0) {
				ret++;
			}
		}
		return ret;
	}
}
